name: DevopShift Laptop Pro
description: A 16-core workhorse with a quiet fan and a battery that lasts through three deployments. Comes with our spill-resistant Cloud Keyboard pre-fitted.

name: DevopShift Laptop Air
description: Our entry-level laptop — fanless, silent, and tuned for reading dashboards on long train rides. Yes, it still compiles Rust.

name: DevopShift Phone X
description: Six rear cameras, two of which actually do something. A holographic notification ribbon knows when you are about to be paged.

name: DevopShift Phone Mini
description: A compact phone for people who want fewer features and a longer battery life. Pairs cleanly with the Earbuds for an actually-pleasant commute.

name: DevopShift Headphones Pro
tagline: Block out the entire open office
description: Over-ear, noise cancelling, and tuned by a single grumpy audio engineer. Battery lasts a full sprint planning session and most of the retro.

name: DevopShift Earbuds
description: True-wireless buds with surprisingly decent ANC and a charging case the size of a stack of business cards.
